usedFor: Signupgenius organises groups, and “Create Group Member” adds a person to a group.

bestTemplate.name: “Record Created Or Updated” in Airtable, then “Create Group Member” in Signupgenius
bestTemplate.why: A new or changed record adds the person to the group, so lists stay in step.

watchOut: A trigger that fires on updates as well as new records may run “Create Group Member” twice for one person.
